historicalLibrary.selection: Ambient configured loadout library; not an explicit --library argument.
historicalLibrary.limitation: Counts were retained in controlled runner logs. Per-skill origins, source revisions, exact accepted names and original content were not captured at run time; the intended public corpus cannot be verified retrospectively.

historicalIsolation.network: Shared host network, including unrelated loopback listeners. New runs require pasta isolation.
historicalIsolation.nodeChecks: Legacy exit-code grading could accept an early module exit before assertions. New runs require expected test-case completion evidence.
historicalIsolation.resume: Use a fresh output directory with the new harness; legacy protocol and unknown library fingerprints cannot be resumed as equivalent.

quotaEvidenceMethod.identification: Match OpenCode processes by ancestry to the owned benchmark runner, its cwd and requested output directory. Match the namespace home inode/device to the owned session home.
quotaEvidenceMethod.input: Read each owned session data/opencode/log/*.log in memory, taking only its final 1000000 characters. No log text persisted.
quotaEvidenceMethod.counterSql: select json_extract(data,'$.type'),count(*) from part group by 1
quotaEvidenceMethod.projection: Persist only marker booleans, recognized constant error classes, integer internal retry counts and step/compaction counts, with UTC observation time. No HTTP status or reset time was inferred.
quotaEvidenceMethod.stop: After validating the usage marker for the owned sessions, freeze both schedulers, terminate them, and verify sandbox descendants exited before cleanup. Interrupted rows were not reconstructed.
